profile.headline: Results-Driven Key Account & Operations Manager | 15+ Years in B2B/B2C Sales, Market Expansion, and Business Development | Expertise in Data Analytics, Web Development, and AI Automation Workflow
profile.summary:
With 15+ years of experience as a result-oriented Key Account Management Professional & Operations Manager, I have spearheaded teams to champion B2B & B2C across diverse geographies. I excel in formulating long-term business strategies, turning around operations, and driving profitability. Adept at identifying client requirements, mentoring team members, and executing elaborate campaigns for business growth.

As an enterprising junior data analyst and Google Certified Data Analytics Professional, I possess skills in market research, competitor analysis, and data validation. I am proficient in Excel, R programming, and SQL.

Additionally, I bring 1+ years of experience as a freelance web development professional, specializing in designing, building, and maintaining websites for optimal user experience and increased sales. Skilled in CSS, XHTML, JavaScript, and jQuery, I collaborate effectively with web developers and ensure client satisfaction.

If you seek a versatile professional with expertise in data analytics, key account management, and web development, let's connect and discuss how I can contribute to your projects.

positions.title: Problem solver& Associate
positions.description:
*Skilled in problem-solving, addressing inventory discrepancies, and proactively finding solutions by utilizing Amazon Wiki Pages tools like FCRearch, Dr.SKU, WebUI, Pandash, TransshipQA, IOPrints, Bind/Unbind Hierarchy, and Mastermind for both Retail and FBA.
*Inspecting and preparing inventory for storage or shipment. This includes verifying the accuracy of merchandise, ensuring proper labeling, and organizing items according to storage protocols.
*Involves unpacking and organizing merchandise that arrives at the warehouse. Perform carefully sort and store items in their designated locations, maintaining an organized and efficient warehouse environment.
*Conducting accurately sorting merchandise and preparing it for shipment. This involves ensuring that items are properly labeled, packaged, and ready for delivery. Pay attention to detail and accuracy contribute to meeting strict timelines and ensuring order accuracy.
*Assist and guide associates to understand the causes of errors and collaborate with team members  ensures that tasks are completed efficiently and that the team meets its targets.
*Provide prompt and efficient support to the operations team, responding to associate and vendor inquiries.
positions.insights: Skills: Collaborative Problem Solving · Team Management & Leadership · Client Relationship Management · Key Account Management · New Business Development

positions.title: Ecommerce Business Owner
positions.description:
*With a deep understanding of ecommerce ecosystem,sales and business development expert with hands on experience of Amazon/Ebay/Walmart Seller Account Setup, Product search, Product sourcing, product launch, A/B split testing, Listing optimization, keyword research, keywork ranking, PPC campaigns, Social Media marketing/Brand Management, Manage Reviews,Inventory management/forecasting, Fulfillment by Amazon(FBA),Brand Registry,Customer Support 
*As a former ecommerce entrepreneur and years of experience in business and e-commerce including a successful track record of developing and growing businesses from 0 to millions of dollars revenue in just 4 years.
*Have access to a business from the ground-up, including all the tools and techniques necessary to become a successful Amazon/eBay/Walmart seller.Directed business promotion/marketing initiatives and efficiently processed customer queries & complaints,enhance market position & achieve 100% targets
*Conducted competition analysis & deployed in-depth knowledge of latest industry-based trends & marketing developments Prospecting, Research & Issue Resolution
*Adept at building businesses & teams from scratch & spearheading Strategy, P&L Management, Marketing & Operations to lead data-driven decision-making, render consumer impact analysis & achieve astronomical growth with respect to profitability & customer acquisition
*Familiarity with Amazon research tools such as junglescount,merchantword,viral launch,sellics and helium 10 to harvest keyword data for listing optimizations and ad targeting. 
*Highly skilled in analyzing sales data to ensure business expansion & growth,Able to troubleshot,update,resolve catalog issues by leveraging Amazon support resources
*Familiar with all the custom T-Shirt printing customize platform like Amazon,Merch,ETSY etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Seller Central · ppc · E-Commerce · Account Management · Online Advertising · Marketing Strategy

positions.title: Business Develops Manager & OEM Project Manager
positions.description:
A leading medical supplier for Chemiluminescence Immunoassay Analyzer/Reagents,Biochemistry Analyzer/Reagents,and more.List in Shenzhen Stock: SHE:300832
*Driven by a single-minded focus on the company’s success, helped to develop 5 OEM customers with my own network resources within one year and each customer signed $10M contract yearly. Also helped to achieve the company’s goals by ranking top 1 in sales and organized/collaborated with different department to lead the company to obtain FDA application approval without paying any cost while the company failed to work and paid $1M with the third-party FDA consultant.
*Data-driven management with a passion to learn and excel in end-to-end business development life cycle encompassing cold-calling, lead generation, pitching, negotiation & deal closing. Armed with real-world sales experience and skilled at product demos, up-selling, and processing customer feedback to enhance the product offering. Proficient in leveraging CRMs to automate sales processes & generate analytical reports for insightful decision-making.
*Managed top & bottom-line of business portfolio comprising conferences, Seminars, customized events, etc. & media offerings. Catered to all the sectors of B2B community for key account customer regions & generated business growth rapidly.
*Monitor market development in terms of product application trends,track major competitors, key market trends, and take/propose the actions to grow of main customers and overseeing new project initiatives and developed a new product to fit the market trend, the newest technology chemistry analyzer in the market.
positions.insights: Skills: B2B Marketing · Business Analysis · New Business Development · Business Strategy · Business Planning · Business-to-Business (B2B) · Business Relationship Management

A leading company of clinical Diagnostics in Shanghai China Since 1980,the product arrange covers from In-Virtro Diagnostic Reagent,Laboratory Diagnostic Instruments like Semi-Auto/Fully Auto Clinical Chemistry Analyzer, Micro-plate Washer,Micro-plate Reader,Amutomatic De-capping Centrifuge,Disposables items For Lab & Hospital Use,Stock :002022.SZ 
*Generated 50% increase in overall sales and 35% increase in revenue in 4 months

Possesses a diverse experience of working with established global brands as well as start-ups. Proficient at closing deals worth millions of dollars. *Gain the sole and unique OEM supplier for many top brands in india,US,European countries.
